Title: Authentic sumo training experience in Tokyo. Amita Sumo Dojo
Description:
Our Authentic Sumo Experience has been produced by Netflix "Sanctuary" Sumo Director: Takeshi Amitani. With this experience, you can practice authentic sumo wrestling on a real sumo ring, wearing a genuine sumo mawashi, and with real sumo wrestlers.  Enjoy Unique Martial Arts "Budo" Sports Class in Tokyo, Japan!

Participation is open to everyone. We gladly embrace beginners, individuals of all genders, children, members of the LGBT+ community, Muslims, and many others.


[Exercise Example]
(1) Ice break
　 Participants are invited to touch the ring
and experience the size of a sumo wrestler.
　 We will also check your level of sumo knowledge.
(2) Wrap up the Sumo belt(Mawashi)
(3) Preparation of the ring
(4) Explanation of sumo rules
(5) Shiko(Leg Stamping)/the most basic movement of sumo
(6) Koshiwari (sumo squat)
(7) Gymnastics (injury prevention)
(8) Suriashi (Foot work practice)
(9) Teppo (Pushing practice)
(10)Butsukari(Charging practice)
(11)Sumo Bouts!! (As much as you want!)

～After the Sumo Experience
(1) Commemorative photos, etc.
(2) Shower
(3) Goodbye. Have a nice day!

Title: Authentic sumo training experience in Tokyo Shinjuku for Group. Tokyo Sumo Land
Description:
Our Authentic Sumo Experience has been produced by Netflix "Sanctuary" Sumo Director: Takeshi Amitani. With this experience, you can practice authentic sumo wrestling with real sumo wrestlers.  Enjoy Unique Martial Arts "Budo" Sports Class in Tokyo, Japan!

The experience is on a mat, not in a sumo ring. There is no need to wash the dirt off your feet afterwards, making it easy and quick.

Participation is open to everyone. We gladly embrace beginners, individuals of all genders, children, members of the LGBT+ community, Muslims, and many others.

(1)   Sumo Wrestler Self-Introduction

(9)   Learning sumo rituals and history

(10)  Watch a sumo match featuring real sumo wrestlers

(11)  Q&A

(12)  Photos session
